thread:
maria.g (AE): quick sync — merchant wants final POC schedule + KMS setup plan. also asked about pen test window and whether BYOK/HSM changes billing. can we confirm timeline?

shawn (SE): i pushed the draft SOW yesterday. timeline wise we can do a 2-week lab POC then a 1-week cutover dry run. is that acceptable?

eli (Crypto Eng): for BYOK/HSM there are two callouts: 1) network allowlist + mutual TLS to the HSM proxy, 2) rotation window ops. both add ~2 engineering days for runbook & infra.

natalie (Customer Ops): customer asked about additional costs — do we bill for HSM throughput or a flat setup?

shawn (SE): pricing: for Dedicated/HSM we bill a one-time onboarding fee (covers ops runbook + attestation) + monthly reserved capacity. throughput tiers only if they want guaranteed IOPS higher than baseline. i'll paste numbers to the quote after eli confirms ops scope.

eli (Crypto Eng): re: pen test window — we require a signed test plan and a 48h notice. for BYOK scenarios we need the test vectors to be NEGATIVE (no key-export attempts), and a read-only attestation flow. also: bring-your-own-key means we don't hold CKMS, so legal needs to confirm liability.

maria.g (AE): ok good — customer legal will want KMS liability language. natalie, can you spin up a short checklist for legal + security?

natalie (Customer Ops): will do. draft checklist items: key custody confirmation, rotation SLA (we support orchestrated rotation but customer triggers), incident response contact, and encryption-in-transit proof. adding pen-test signoff clause.

eli (Crypto Eng): config notes for their infra team (share with sec):
```
# allowlist example for HSM proxy
ALLOW_FROM=203.0.113.45/32
PORT=443 (mTLS)
# ensure outbound 443 to redwood-hsm-gw.redwood.local
```

shawn (SE): also: during POC we'll run our lightweight attestation flow (no key material leaves customer side). if they ask for HSM-backed CMKs, we can demo with an HSM emulator in week 1 and switch to customer HSM in week 3.

maria.g (AE): timeline proposed to customer:
- week 0: legal/security questionnaires + pen-test plan signoff
- week 1-2: lab POC (attestation + basic load)
- week 3: dry run cutover with BYOK handshake
- week 4: final acceptance

natalie (Customer Ops): flagged two enterprise blockers: (1) customer wants key rotation window under 1hr — we need to confirm our orchestration SLAs, (2) they want HSM attestation logs retained for 90 days on our side. eli, feasible?

eli (Crypto Eng): rotation under 1hr is tight for multi-az with large token caches. we can support staged rotation with rolling keys and <1hr for small keysets, but need to mark as an SLA exception for >100k active sessions. attestation logs 90 days: okay if they pay for extended retention add-on.

maria.g (AE): perfect. i'll update the SOW with exceptions and the retention add-on option. shawn, eli — anything else to raise before i send to the customer?

shawn (SE): maybe call out fallback policy: if HSM proxy unreachable, we failover to a soft-wrapped key in Dedicated (customer opt-in). that's usually a blocker for finance.

eli (Crypto Eng): agreed. add fallback + explicit approval in runbook. also include crypto checklist for pen-test: no export attempts, read-only attestation, signed non-destructive testing.

secops-bot: Reminder: attach completed security questionnaire to deal in SFDC before advancing stage to "Contract Review".

maria.g (AE): thanks team — i'll send the updated SOW + checklist to the customer this afternoon and loop legal. will post the final thread here when done. :thumbsup:
